regulator: AGETRANSP (Agência Reguladora de Serviços Públicos Concedidos de Transportes Aquaviários... do Estado do Rio de Janeiro) regulates the state ferry lines; operations transitioned from CCR Barcas to the Barcas Rio consortium on 12 Feb 2025 under the state Service Provision model (Secretaria de Transporte e Mobilidade Urbana). Flexboats are licensed municipally + Capitania dos Portos (Navy) for vessel/crew certification. Mangaratiba levies a R$10.30/leg embarkation tax (Decreto 12.911/2023); Angra introduced the Viva Angra visitor tax in 2026.
annual_basis_note: No official line-level annual passenger series is published for the Ilha Grande crossings (Barcas Rio/AGETRANSP report system-wide figures dominated by Guanabara Bay). Because Ilha Grande is boat-only, the Prefeitura's 1.2M visitors/year is the best official proxy for annual crossing demand (each visitor = 2 boat legs minimum, implying ~2.4M+ passenger crossings/year across Conceição de Jacareí, Angra and Mangaratiba). Economics for the sealed Angra–Abraão corridor are UNCHANGED by this record (AGETRANSP T1 basis).
gaps: Line-level split of Barcas Rio ridership (Angra–IG vs Mangaratiba–IG) not published
